facts.business: Technocrats Plasma Systems Limited is engaged in the manufacture of plasma cutting machines, welding equipment and customised automation systems for metal fabrication and related industries.
key_risks: Competition influenced by pricing, technology, product performance, reliability, delivery timelines, after-sales service and brand reputation
Changing customer requirements, technological developments and competitive pricing may affect margins and market share
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for related party transactions for FY 2026-27 for an aggregate value not exceeding Rs. 100 crores, to be carried out in ordinary course of business and at arm's length basis.
